data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared limit? I propose 18 tons each this month: that earns each of us $18,000 and leaves 10 tons. Next month, the lake would have either 100 tons or 20 tons—not a guaranteed refill. Going forward, we should base our limits on the actual stock and always leave at least 5 tons. If we start with 20, for example, we could take 3 tons each. Since catches are revealed afterward, we can check whether everyone kept the agreement and discuss any departures. John, would you support that?
